name: collections/harness-hub
title: GGUF harness adapters ship for LFM and Twil coding agents
summary: Nine GGUF harness adapters are ready for Liquid AI LFM2.5-24B and LFM3 and for thewebAI Twil-8B, tuned for pi, Hermes, and OpenCode. On the held-out data-analysis set, LFM3 gained up to 43% tool efficiency and 15% accuracy, and Twil-8B gained up to 37% tool-call efficiency.

appearances.summary: A Hermes harness adapter for Liquid AI's LFM2.5-24B is out, with no accuracy drop on held-out test tasks and a reported 20% efficiency gain. A GGUF build can be loaded directly in llama.cpp.

appearances.title: Hermes LoRA for LFM2.5-24B
appearances.summary: A new LoRA adapts LiquidAI's LFM2.5-24B to the Nous Research Hermes agent. The authors report no accuracy drop on held-out tasks and a 20% efficiency gain, and they also published a GGUF for llama.cpp.

appearances.title: LFM2.5-24B adapters cut coding-agent tool calls
appearances.summary: Hugging Face released LoRA adapters on Liquid AI's LFM2.5-24B for the Pi and Claude Code harnesses, aimed at more efficient agentic coding. The Pi adapter uses up to 40% fewer tool calls.
